conclusions: Published prescribed-head GW exchange is an interval state-transition observable.
Within P4 evidence, interval exchange error equals negative storage-transition error to ledger/serialization precision under shared top forcing.
G12-to-G16 interval-response plateau occurs in both Layer-ROM and same-partition Richards, so it is not a Layer-ROM closure signature.
Cumulative exchange/storage and interval exchange are separate fidelity purposes; B01 cumulative fidelity still improves G12-to-G16 while interval fidelity does not.
GW_LOCAL_DARCY is a separate, not-yet-authoritative diagnostic purpose and must not be conflated with published GW_EXCHANGE.
